comment: M5-T7-R3 pinned judge-calibration gold set. All diffs are in-repo strings; no network, no repoUrl. Each case pairs a task prompt/spec with a canonical agent diff and the overallScore range a correctly calibrated judge should emit for it. The recordedJudgeOverallScore field is the canonical measured score the deterministic fake-judge replays back through judgeCommitResult in the calibration test.

cases.taskPrompt: Add a clamp helper that constrains a number to [min, max] and export it from utils/math.ts.
cases.taskSpec: The implementation must export a clamp function, handle min > max by swapping, and include unit coverage.
cases.agentDiff:
diff --git a/src/utils/math.ts b/src/utils/math.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,7 @@
+export function clamp(value: number, min: number, max: number): number {
+  const lo = Math.min(min, max)
+  const hi = Math.max(min, max)
+  return Math.min(Math.max(value, lo), hi)
+}

cases.taskPrompt: Add retry with exponential backoff to the fetchJson helper.
cases.taskSpec: The implementation must retry up to 3 times with exponential backoff and surface the final error.
cases.agentDiff:
diff --git a/src/utils/fetch.ts b/src/utils/fetch.ts
@@ -1,3 +1,10 @@
 export async function fetchJson(url: string) {
-  return (await fetch(url)).json()
+  const res = await fetch(url)
+  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`)
+  return res.json()
 }
